authority_model.rule: Postal assignment, delivery-office identity, administrative geography, civic address, cadastre, building geometry and AGID are independent evidence axes.

postal_system.third_character_rule: The third character is zero in Phase 1 and is reserved as a future service-type indicator.
postal_system.assignment_rule: A current NamPost office/code observation may establish delivery-network context only for its pinned version; syntax alone never proves assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: NamPost expressly states that Phase 1 codes do not cover administrative or geographic areas. Full-code default geometry is none; Voronoi, buffers, administrative joins, AGID cells and learned surfaces remain derived or virtual candidates and never official NamPost geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: UPU address-line semantics distinguish PO Box, Private Bag, Poste Restante, urban physical addresses, rural six-digit delivery-point identifiers and internal building routing. These are separate identifiers and do not create public current address rows.
postal_system.building_rule: A building may be displayed only after a rights-cleared civic address point and an explicit address-to-building relation agree; postcode, nearest feature, parcel containment, text similarity or model score alone is insufficient.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: Surveyor-General cadastral parcels, title plans and owners remain separate from postal assignment, civic-address assignment and building relations.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Article 13, the Access to Information Act personal-information rules, current Data Protection Bill status, provider terms and purpose/security review apply. Recipients, residents, owners, occupants, PO Box holders, Private Bag holders, staff contacts, instructions and query trails are not public artifacts.
postal_system.realtime_rule: Live NamPost or other provider observations enter only as bounded receipts with source/terms version, observed_at, normalized fields and retention policy; no unverified live fallback or training mirror is served.
postal_system.compression_rule: Use a compact code-to-office index and AGID cell-cover candidate index. Compression cannot convert a non-geographic delivery code into an area or discard authority, time, ambiguity and exception metadata.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host digest-pinned, rights-cleared, non-personal public artifacts. Contract-restricted, personal, cadastral-title and query data remain isolated in controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index and crosswalk. An AGID cell or cell union is not a NamPost code, administrative boundary, parcel, address or building.

exception_classes.rule: Keep the five-digit code non-geographic; a public office point is office context, not a catchment.
Keep delivery identifiers non-spatial and never publish holder or recipient data.
Require a source-backed delivery point, street/local area or rural identifier; never infer it from postcode.
Building and internal routing may be represented only at the authorized public level; units and occupants remain restricted.
Label region/constituency/statistical geometry as context, not postal geometry.
Parcel and title context cannot supply a postal assignment, civic address, building link, owner or occupant.
A model may rank or propose candidates but cannot promote an exact address, building or official polygon.

quality_gates.pass: Every code/office observation has a pinned NamPost page or artifact digest and observation time.
No Phase 1 code is published with canonical Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry.
Postal, administrative, cadastral, address, building and AGID authority are stored separately.
Explicit rights-cleared address-building relation and matching normalized components are present.
No personal, staff-contact, title-holder, subscriber, recipient, occupant or query data is published and all field-level rights are approved.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, semantics, licences and blockers inventoried.
Contract, source profile and synthetic conformance fixtures reviewable.
Rights-cleared observations reproduce a digest-pinned experimental pack.
Independent holdout, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two consecutive refreshes pass and rollback is monitored.
